title: TraceArtifact
description: Phase 3.2-B data contract. Structural placeholder for the full task-execution trace chain required by TRACEABILITY_CONTRACT.md section 2: task -> candidate_discovery -> candidate_set -> reranking -> selection -> selected_evidence -> reasoning_context -> reasoning_output -> final_response. Per AUDIT.md section 10, no historical component ever wired a live candidate-discovery/reranking/selection pipeline to a live reasoning layer in one execution, so most of these fields have no producer yet in 3.2-B -- every field except schema_version/task_id/run_id is optional and nullable so this schema can be populated incrementally as later Phase 3 stages implement each layer, without ever needing a breaking schema change. This is a structure-only definition: it carries no metric fields and computes nothing.

run_id.description: Back-reference to the EvaluationRun this trace belongs to, where known.

task_id.description: Identifies the task this trace reconstructs the execution of.

task.description: Snapshot of the task as presented, for trace reconstruction. Null until a stage populates it.

candidate_discovery.description: Record of the candidate discovery step (channels used, parameters). Null: candidate discovery is not yet implemented (per PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 15/17, this is a distinct, not-yet-built layer).

candidate_set.description: The candidate memory_ids produced by candidate discovery, before reranking. Null until candidate discovery exists.

reranking.description: Record of the reranking step (e.g. per-candidate scores/order). Null: reranking is not yet implemented as a separated layer.

selection.description: Record of the evidence selection step (budget/redundancy/independence decisions). Null: selection is not yet implemented as a separated layer.

selected_evidence.description: The memory_ids evidence selection chose to pass to reasoning. Null until selection exists.

reasoning_context.description: Reference/snapshot of the assembled reasoning context sent to the reasoning layer, subject to LEAKAGE_AND_VISIBILITY_CONTRACT.md. Null: reasoning-context assembly is not yet implemented in 3.2-B.

reasoning_output.description: Raw reasoning-layer (Qwen3-8B) output record. Null: no reasoning-layer integration exists yet (Qwen integration is explicitly out of scope for 3.2-B).

final_response.description: The final answer/decision produced. Null until a reasoning layer exists to produce one.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this trace record was created/last appended to.
